items.title_en: GEMOR-GS: Global Extrinsic-calibration-refined Mapping and Online Relocalization for 3D Gaussian-Splatting SLAM
items.title_zh: GEMOR-GS：面向3D高斯泼溅SLAM的全局外参标定精化建图与在线重定位
items.abstract_en: Photorealistic and metrically consistent world representations are a primary requirement for LiDAR--inertial--visual SLAM systems that serve robots over continuous operation. 3D Gaussian splatting makes such representations attainable by supplying an explicit, renderable, and queryable scene model. We present GEMOR-GS (Global Extrinsic-calibration-refined Mapping and Online Relocalization for 3D Gaussian-Splatting SLAM) to make the Gaussian map geometrically accurate, globally refined, and re-enterable, providing a better appearance for robot perception and decision-making. To improve the 3DGS map, the LiDAR--camera extrinsic is first estimated offline by direct-method alignment over dedicated calibration segments and reused by all following online and offline processes. Under the calibrated geometry, keyframe poses and Gaussian parameters are refined alternately under a gated differentiable-rendering and LiDAR--projection objective. The final global reconstruction is then rebuilt from the refined keyframe schema with all online constraints lifted. For the robot SLAM lifecycle, the method recovers the pose from the 3DGS map after tracking loss through an XFeat bypass map, RANSAC-PnP coarse localization, and Gaussian RGB-D warp refinement. Experiments on one self-collected and five public sequences quantify each element: the offline reconstruction wins all paired keyframes against the online map by 14.3--19.9 dB, improves PSNR by approximately 9 dB over Gaussian-LIC2, and achieves 86--100% held-out relocalization success tied to extrinsic quality. The results show that GEMOR-GS improves the geometric accuracy, appearance fidelity, and re-enterability of the 3DGS map, serving as a dependable robot world model for SLAM and downstream tasks.
items.abstract_zh: 逼真且度量一致的世界表示是在连续运行中为机器人服务的LiDAR--惯性--视觉SLAM系统的主要需求。3D高斯泼溅通过提供显式、可渲染且可查询的场景模型，使此类表示成为可能。我们提出GEMOR-GS（面向3D高斯泼溅SLAM的全局外参标定精化建图与在线重定位），使高斯地图在几何上准确、全局精化且可重新进入，为机器人感知和决策提供更好的外观。为改进3DGS地图，首先在专用标定段上通过直接法对齐离线估计LiDAR--相机外参，并将其复用于所有后续在线和离线过程。在标定几何下，关键帧位姿和高斯参数在门控可微渲染与LiDAR--投影目标下交替精化。随后，在解除所有在线约束的情况下，从精化后的关键帧模式重建最终全局重建。针对机器人SLAM生命周期，该方法在跟踪丢失后通过XFeat旁路地图、RANSAC-PnP粗定位和高斯RGB-D warp精化，从3DGS地图中恢复位姿。在一个自采集序列和五个公开序列上的实验量化了每个要素：离线重建在所有配对关键帧上以14.3--19.9 dB优于在线地图，相比Gaussian-LIC2将PSNR提高约9 dB，并取得与外参质量相关的86--100%留出集重定位成功率。结果表明，GEMOR-GS提高了3DGS地图的几何精度、外观保真度和可重新进入性，可作为SLAM及下游任务的可靠机器人世界模型。

items.title_en: Scale-Consistent Monocular Fisheye Visual Odometry via Spherical Bundle Adjustment-Guided Unsupervised Depth Learning
items.title_zh: 通过球面光束法平差引导的无监督深度学习实现尺度一致的单目鱼眼视觉里程计
items.abstract_en: The wide field of view of fisheye cameras and the simplicity of a monocular setup make monocular fisheye visual odometry (VO) attractive for robotic localization and mapping. Nevertheless, scale drift remains a major challenge over long trajectories. Unsupervised depth learning can help to mitigate this issue, but the pronounced distortion of fisheye images poses challenges for accurate depth estimation. This article presents S$^2$D-FVO, a monocular fisheye VO framework integrating spherical bundle adjustment (SBA)-guided unsupervised depth learning to improve scale consistency and depth estimation accuracy. Given that pixel reprojection residuals do not uniformly reflect angular deviations between viewing rays and that the first-order linearization of a scalar angular reprojection residual is insensitive to perturbations along one tangent direction, SBA employs tangent-space angular reprojection residuals derived from the spherical logarithmic map. These residuals retain sensitivity along both tangent directions, with their norms equal to the corresponding scalar angular residuals. A median depth-based scale regularization term is further integrated into SBA to constrain the reconstruction scale. Building on these formulations, SBA replaces the pose estimation network during unsupervised depth learning, providing more reliable relative poses for view synthesis. In turn, depth estimates from the well-trained depth estimation network provide scale references for SBA, improving scale consistency while allowing individual 3-D landmark positions to be refined. Extensive experiments conducted on multiple public datasets, as well as two newly collected large-scale datasets, demonstrate that the proposed framework outperforms representative existing approaches in both depth and trajectory estimation accuracy and is applicable to different camera models.
items.abstract_zh: 鱼眼相机的宽视场和单目设置的简单性，使单目鱼眼视觉里程计（VO）对机器人定位与建图具有吸引力。然而，尺度漂移在长轨迹上仍是主要挑战。无监督深度学习有助于缓解该问题，但鱼眼图像的显著畸变给准确深度估计带来挑战。本文提出S$^2$D-FVO，一种集成球面光束法平差（SBA）引导的无监督深度学习的单目鱼眼VO框架，以提高尺度一致性和深度估计精度。鉴于像素重投影残差不能一致地反映视线之间的角度偏差，且标量角度重投影残差的一阶线性化对沿一个切线方向的扰动不敏感，SBA采用由球面对数映射导出的切空间角度重投影残差。这些残差在两个切线方向上均保持敏感性，其范数等于对应的标量角度残差。进一步将基于中值深度的尺度正则项集成到SBA中，以约束重建尺度。基于这些公式，SBA在无监督深度学习期间替代位姿估计网络，为视图合成提供更可靠的相对位姿。反过来，训练良好的深度估计网络提供的深度估计为SBA提供尺度参考，在提高尺度一致性的同时允许精化各个三维路标位置。在多个公开数据集以及两个新采集的大规模数据集上进行的大量实验表明，所提框架在深度和轨迹估计精度上均优于代表性现有方法，并适用于不同相机模型。
items.comment: 34 pages, 18 figures

items.title_en: Semantic Extraction Framework for Goal-Oriented V2X Communication Supporting Safe Intersection Passage
items.title_zh: 支持安全交叉口通行的面向目标V2X通信语义提取框架
items.abstract_en: This paper proposes a transmitter-side semantic extraction framework for goal-oriented Vehicle-to-Everything (V2X) communication supporting safe intersection passage. Instead of transmitting raw sensory data, roadside infrastructure extracts task-relevant semantic information from video and traffic-signal sequences and organizes them into compact semantic packets for low-latency driving-decision assistance. The intersection-passing problem is formulated as a set of traffic tasks under Japanese traffic regulations, and the proposed pipeline generates perception and intent semantics through object detection, object tracking, region-of-interest (ROI)-based semantic extraction, and recommended-action generation. The framework is implemented and evaluated on a self-constructed, CARLA-based single-vehicle dataset collected under clear weather conditions. Experimental results show high recommended-action accuracy within the tested task set, while the mean processing latency remains below the frame interval of the 15~fps input video.
items.abstract_zh: 本文提出一种发射端语义提取框架，用于支持安全交叉口通行的面向目标车联网（V2X）通信。路侧基础设施不传输原始感知数据，而是从视频和交通信号序列中提取任务相关语义信息，并将其组织为紧凑语义包，以低时延辅助驾驶决策。交叉口通行问题被形式化为日本交通法规下的一组交通任务，所提流程通过目标检测、目标跟踪、基于感兴趣区域（ROI）的语义提取和推荐动作生成来产生感知语义和意图语义。该框架在自行构建的、基于CARLA的单车数据集上实现并评估，该数据集在晴朗天气条件下采集。实验结果表明，在测试任务集内具有较高的推荐动作准确率，同时平均处理时延保持在15 fps输入视频的帧间隔以下。

items.title_en: ForagerSim: Evaluating Embodied Map-Based Reasoning in Large-Scale Dynamic Worlds
items.title_zh: ForagerSim：在大规模动态世界中评估具身地图推理
items.abstract_en: Animals build cognitive maps of vast environments, use them to perform map-based navigation, and might even be reusing the same circuitry used in spatial reasoning for creating and using maps of arbitrary task-spaces. In contrast, current embodied AI systems either rely on hand-engineered mapping pipelines, which break in the presence of unmodeled dynamics and are restricted to metric space, or on learned policies that rarely form map-like representations at all. Developing architectures that could learn to build and use map-like representations as flexibly as animals is, however, difficult because few embodied AI benchmarks actually require map-based reasoning. To address this, we present ForagerSim --- an interdisciplinary research platform and simulation environment focused on embodied tasks that require map-based reasoning, with scenarios ranging from mobile-robot search and rescue to animal foraging in both complex mazes and vast, potentially infinite open areas. ForagerSim is highly modular and allows modifying independent axes of difficulty related to perception (abstract 2D sensing to full RGB or LiDAR), scale (room-scale to multi-km scale), topology (open-fields to complex mazes), dynamics (smoke, debris, sensorimotor failures and others) and tasks (from simple 2D coverage to foraging-inspired well-alternation tasks). We compare reinforcement learning baselines with a simple engineered robotics stack and a human player on 8 example worlds which show how different difficulty axes affect existing methods. Our results show that, when sensing is simplified to 2D, learned policies can perform multi-object search and well-alternation tasks surprisingly well in simple topologies, but they fall short of human performance in larger or more complex-topology environments where map-based baselines perform well, suggesting that map-based reasoning is the bottleneck in these scenarios.
items.abstract_zh: 动物会为广阔环境构建认知地图，利用它们执行基于地图的导航，甚至可能复用空间推理中用于创建和使用任意任务空间地图的同一神经回路。相比之下，当前具身AI系统要么依赖手工设计的建图流水线，这些流水线在存在未建模动态时会失效且局限于度量空间；要么依赖学习型策略，而这些策略很少形成类似地图的表示。然而，开发能够像动物一样灵活学习构建和使用类似地图表示的架构是困难的，因为很少有具身AI基准真正要求基于地图的推理。为解决这一问题，我们提出ForagerSim——一个跨学科研究平台和仿真环境，聚焦于需要基于地图推理的具身任务，场景范围从移动机器人搜救到动物在复杂迷宫以及广阔、可能无限的开放区域中觅食。ForagerSim高度模块化，允许修改与感知（从抽象2D感知到完整RGB或LiDAR）、尺度（从房间尺度到多公里尺度）、拓扑（从开阔场地到复杂迷宫）、动态（烟雾、碎片、感觉运动故障等）和任务（从简单2D覆盖到受觅食启发的well-alternation任务）相关的独立难度轴。我们在8个示例世界上将强化学习基线、一个简单的工程化机器人栈和一名人类玩家进行比较，展示不同难度轴如何影响现有方法。我们的结果表明，当感知简化为2D时，学习型策略在简单拓扑中执行多目标搜索和well-alternation任务的表现出奇地好，但在更大或拓扑更复杂的环境中，它们达不到人类表现，而基于地图的基线在这些环境中表现良好，这表明基于地图的推理是这些场景中的瓶颈。

items.title_en: Intent-Informed Model Predictive Control for Shared Autonomy in Remote Manipulation Tasks
items.title_zh: 用于远程操作任务中共享自主的意图信息驱动模型预测控制
items.abstract_en: Shared autonomy is a control paradigm that combines human cognitive abilities with robot precision to enable effective remote manipulation in complex environments. A key challenge is how to adapt the level of autonomy using information extracted from the human, task, and/or environment. In this paper, we propose a novel arbitration strategy that dynamically adjusts the level of autonomy in the system using the entropy of a belief distribution derived from a multimodal intent inference. Human intent is modeled with a Dynamic Bayesian Network (DBN), which updates beliefs over goals given real-time operator gaze data and robot arm motion during teleoperation. We then formulate the blending of human input and autonomous control as a Model Predictive Control (MPC) problem, where the system's autonomous behavior is guided by the belief distribution. This approach enables continuous, gradual transitions across the full spectrum of autonomy levels, from direct teleoperation to full autonomy. To validate our approach, we conducted experiments to compare the performance of our proposed algorithm against two MPC-based shared autonomy methods. Compared to the baselines, our approach achieved reductions of at least 61% in object retrieval time, 44% in trajectory length, and 60% in human control input. Participants reported high perceived control, predictability, intent recognition, and responsiveness, along with low workload.
items.abstract_zh: 共享自主是一种控制范式，它将人类认知能力与机器人精度相结合，以在复杂环境中实现有效的远程操作。一个关键挑战是如何利用从人类、任务和/或环境中提取的信息来调整自主水平。在本文中，我们提出了一种新颖的仲裁策略，该策略利用由多模态意图推断得到的信念分布的熵来动态调整系统中的自主水平。人类意图使用动态贝叶斯网络（DBN）建模，该网络在遥操作期间根据实时操作员注视数据和机器人手臂运动来更新对目标的信念。然后，我们将人类输入与自主控制的融合表述为一个模型预测控制（MPC）问题，其中系统的自主行为由信念分布引导。该方法能够实现从直接遥操作到完全自主的整个自主水平范围内的连续、渐进过渡。为验证我们的方法，我们进行了实验，将所提出算法的性能与两种基于MPC的共享自主方法进行比较。与基线相比，我们的方法在物体检索时间上至少减少了61%，轨迹长度减少了44%，人类控制输入减少了60%。参与者报告了较高的感知控制感、可预测性、意图识别和响应性，以及较低的工作负荷。

items.id: cvf:CVPR2026:Generalized-CVO: Fast and Correspondence-Free Local Point Cl
items.title_en: Generalized-CVO: Fast and Correspondence-Free Local Point Cloud Registration with Second Order Riemannian Optimization
items.title_zh: Generalized-CVO：基于二阶黎曼优化的快速无对应局部点云配准
items.abstract_en: We propose a fast and correspondence-free local point cloud registration method that leverages geometric surface structure and reproducing kernel Hilbert space (RKHS) embeddings. The method represents point clouds as continuous functions with point-wise anisotropic kernels that encode local geometry. This formulation improves alignment along surface normals while relaxing alignment along tangential directions. To solve the resulting registration problem, we propose a second-order on-manifold optimization scheme with approximate Riemannian Hessians, achieving a speedup of up to 10x over the first-order solvers used in prior correspondence-free RKHS-based methods. We demonstrate improved frame-to-frame LiDAR and RGB-D tracking accuracy across diverse indoor and outdoor datasets. On a LiDAR tracking registration task in the driving domain, we achieve a reduction of >55% in both translational and rotational drift in challenging feature-sparse environments. On object registration benchmarks, we show improved robustness over ICP-based methods and further gains when refining global initialization, particularly under moderate misalignment.
items.abstract_zh: 我们提出一种快速且无对应的局部点云配准方法，利用几何表面结构和再生核希尔伯特空间（RKHS）嵌入。该方法将点云表示为具有逐点各向异性核的连续函数，这些核编码局部几何。该形式改善了沿表面法向的对齐，同时放宽了沿切向方向的对齐。为求解所得配准问题，我们提出一种采用近似黎曼Hessian的二阶流形优化方案，相较于先前无对应RKHS方法中使用的一阶求解器，实现最高10倍的加速。我们在多样化的室内和室外数据集上展示了帧到帧LiDAR和RGB-D跟踪精度的提升。在驾驶领域的LiDAR跟踪配准任务中，我们在具有挑战性的特征稀疏环境中将平移和旋转漂移均降低超过55%。在物体配准基准上，我们展示了相较于基于ICP的方法更好的鲁棒性，并且在精化全局初始化时获得进一步增益，尤其是在中等程度失配下。

items.title_en: Ground Reaction Force-Aware Model Predictive Control for Underactuated Upright Physical Assistance
items.title_zh: 用于欠驱动直立物理辅助的地面反作用力感知模型预测控制
items.abstract_en: Many rehabilitation robots execute prescribed motions using reactive tracking controllers that do not explicitly incorporate the user's instantaneous human-ground interaction. This paper presents Ground Reaction Force-Aware Model Predictive Control (GRF-MPC), a framework for upright physical assistance. By integrating live GRF and center of pressure (CoP) measurements directly into a human centroidal dynamics model, GRF-MPC formulates a real-time quadratic program (QP) that optimizes assistive forces and moments over a receding horizon. We deployed GRF-MPC on the Robotic Upright Stand Trainer (RobUST) in an underactuated 4-cable configuration and evaluated it against a fully actuated 8-cable Cartesian impedance baseline in nearly 300 trials across six healthy participants. Across tasks spanning impulsive perturbations, lunge trajectories, and voluntary limits of stability, GRF-MPC reduced peak planar center-of-mass (CoM) error by 19.6% during perturbations, lowered trajectory tracking error by 24.1%, required 28.7% less net mechanical work, and permitted a 45.9% greater normalized voluntary excursion area. The underlying QP solves in under 1 ms, comfortably enabling 100 Hz replanning and demonstrating that incorporating live human-ground interaction into predictive control yields stronger, more transparent physical assistance with half the actuators.
items.abstract_zh: 许多康复机器人使用反应式跟踪控制器执行规定运动，这些控制器并未明确纳入用户瞬时的人-地交互。本文提出地面反作用力感知模型预测控制（GRF-MPC），一种用于直立物理辅助的框架。通过将实时GRF和压力中心（CoP）测量直接集成到人体质心动力学模型中，GRF-MPC构建一个实时二次规划（QP），在滚动时域上优化辅助力和力矩。我们将GRF-MPC部署在Robotic Upright Stand Trainer（RobUST）上，采用欠驱动的4缆绳配置，并在六名健康参与者的近300次试验中，将其与全驱动的8缆绳笛卡尔阻抗基线进行比较。在涵盖脉冲扰动、弓步轨迹和自主稳定性极限的任务中，GRF-MPC在扰动期间将峰值平面质心（CoM）误差降低了19.6%，将轨迹跟踪误差降低了24.1%，所需净机械功减少了28.7%，并允许归一化自主偏移面积增加45.9%。底层QP求解时间低于1 ms，可轻松实现100 Hz重规划，并表明将实时人-地交互纳入预测控制能够以一半的执行器产生更强、更透明的物理辅助。
items.comment: Accepted for publication in IEEE Robotics and Automation Letters (RA-L), October 2026. 8 pages, 5 figures

items.title_en: Map2SLAM: From Streaming Map Prediction to Real-Time SLAM
items.title_zh: Map2SLAM：从流式地图预测到实时SLAM
items.abstract_en: Streaming 3D foundation models (3DFMs) estimate camera poses and dense geometry online, but they fall short of SLAM: their predictions are fixed once emitted, so loop closures cannot correct accumulated drift. With such models already providing strong geometric capability, a central question for SLAM becomes how to schedule their inference and how to keep its results as revisable state. We present Map2SLAM, which keeps LingBot-Map frozen, trains only a lightweight retrieval head, and builds SLAM on the model's inference interface, turning its predictions into observations of an external persistent SLAM state. The front-end tracks every incoming frame with the model's causal streaming inference and decides which frames are written to the persistent state as keyframes. The back-end asynchronously decides when and which past frames to re-observe, re-running the model's joint inference over them with fresh context; verified loop observations correct the trajectory online, and segment observations refine dense geometry after the sequence. All invocations share a single frame encoder pass per image, whose cached features also drive loop retrieval, so frequent re-invocation incurs no additional encoding cost. Map2SLAM achieves state-of-the-art performance on KITTI, VBR, and Oxford Spires, reducing mean ATE by over 40% compared with the best uncalibrated baselines, while maintaining real-time tracking at over 28 FPS at a resolution of $518\times154$ on an NVIDIA RTX 5090D GPU. Please visit our project page at https://robbyant-research.github.io/Map2SLAM/.
items.abstract_zh: 流式3D基础模型（3DFM）可在线估计相机位姿和稠密几何，但它们尚不能达到SLAM的要求：其预测一旦输出便固定不变，因此回环闭合无法校正累积漂移。由于此类模型已提供强大的几何能力，SLAM的一个核心问题变成如何调度其推理，以及如何将其结果保持为可修正状态。我们提出Map2SLAM，它保持LingBot-Map冻结，仅训练一个轻量级检索头，并在模型的推理接口之上构建SLAM，将其预测转化为外部持久SLAM状态的观测。前端使用模型的因果流式推理跟踪每个输入帧，并决定哪些帧作为关键帧写入持久状态。后端异步决定何时以及重新观测哪些过去帧，并在新的上下文下对这些帧重新运行模型的联合推理；经验证的回环观测在线校正轨迹，分段观测在序列结束后细化稠密几何。所有调用对每幅图像共享一次帧编码器前向传播，其缓存特征也用于驱动回环检索，因此频繁重新调用不会产生额外编码成本。Map2SLAM在KITTI、VBR和Oxford Spires上取得最先进性能，与最佳未标定基线相比，平均ATE降低超过40%，同时在NVIDIA RTX 5090D GPU上以518×154分辨率保持超过28 FPS的实时跟踪。请访问我们的项目页面 https://robbyant-research.github.io/Map2SLAM/。
items.comment: 17 pages, 10 figures. Project page: https://robbyant-research.github.io/Map2SLAM/

items.title_en: HomeLoop: A Simulation Framework and Benchmark for Robot-IoT Coordination in Everyday Domestic Assistance and Safety
items.title_zh: HomeLoop：用于日常家庭辅助与安全中机器人-IoT 协调的仿真框架与基准
items.abstract_en: Recent progress in embodied robotics is bringing robots closer to deployment in homes, as vision-language models (VLMs) are demonstrating significant advances in reasoning, making VLM-driven robots promising home assistant agents. These agents will often be introduced into homes that already have cameras, Internet of Things (IoT) devices, and residents with wearables. To fulfill their potential, they need to integrate with existing smart infrastructure and reason through ambiguous scenarios: a smoke alarm may come from a pan about to ignite, a pan already on fire, a resident cooking or a faulty sensor, and each calls for a different response. To that end, we introduce HomeLoop, a simulation framework and benchmark built on Isaac Sim that combines robot bodies, networked devices and wearables, simulated residents and visitors, faulty sensors, and hazards that evolve over time. Our benchmark is composed of 20 tasks across five families grounded in real-world household hazards and needs, and designed so that the same alert can have different causes. A runtime monitor scores each episode with temporal-logic checks on the final outcome and the actions along the way, and every action carries a predefined cost. We evaluate six open-weight and proprietary VLMs. The best achieves a family-balanced score of 61.9%, and across models we see a pattern of over-reaction: failed episodes involving prohibited interventions outnumber those involving missed required interventions by more than two to one, with models often shutting off the stove before investigating the alarm's cause. HomeLoop is an extensible foundation intended for use in research on robot-IoT coordination, long-term memory, proactive assistance, and privacy-safety trade-offs. HomeLoop will be released with 2,100 home layouts that can be automatically furnished in diverse configurations, five robot bodies and 20 networked device types.
items.abstract_zh: 具身机器人学的最新进展正使机器人更接近在家庭中部署，因为视觉-语言模型（VLM）在推理方面展现出显著进步，使由 VLM 驱动的机器人成为有前景的家庭助手智能体。这些智能体常将被引入已经拥有摄像头、物联网（IoT）设备和佩戴可穿戴设备的居民的家庭中。为发挥其潜力，它们需要与现有智能基础设施集成，并对模糊场景进行推理：烟雾报警可能来自即将起火的锅、已经着火的锅、正在做饭的居民或故障传感器，而每种情况需要不同的响应。为此，我们提出 HomeLoop，一个基于 Isaac Sim 构建的仿真框架与基准，它结合了机器人本体、联网设备与可穿戴设备、模拟居民与访客、故障传感器以及随时间演化的危险。我们的基准由五个任务族中的 20 个任务组成，这些任务基于真实家庭危险与需求，并被设计为同一警报可以具有不同原因。运行时监视器通过对最终结果和沿途动作进行时序逻辑检查来为每个回合评分，并且每个动作都带有预定义代价。我们评估了六个开放权重和专有 VLM。最佳模型达到 61.9% 的族平衡分数；跨模型我们观察到一种过度反应模式：涉及禁止干预的失败回合数量，以超过二比一的比例多于涉及遗漏所需干预的失败回合，模型常常在调查警报原因之前关闭炉灶。HomeLoop 是一个可扩展的基础，旨在用于机器人-IoT 协调、长期记忆、主动辅助以及隐私-安全权衡的研究。HomeLoop 将随附 2,100 个可按多样配置自动布置家具的家居布局、五种机器人本体和 20 种联网设备类型一同发布。

items.title_en: GPU-accelerated Incremental Euclidean Distance Transform for Online Motion Planning of Mobile Robots
items.title_zh: 用于移动机器人在线运动规划的GPU加速增量欧氏距离变换
items.abstract_en: In this letter, we present a volumetric mapping system that effectively calculates Occupancy Grid Maps (OGMs) and Euclidean Distance Transforms (EDTs) with parallel computing. Unlike these mappers for high-precision structural reconstruction, our system incrementally constructs global EDT and outputs high-frequency local distance information for online robot motion planning. The proposed system constructs OGM with massive amount of data from multiple types of sensor inputs. Using GPU programming techniques, the system quickly computes EDT in parallel within local volume. The new observation is continuously integrated into the global EDT using the parallel wavefront algorithm while preserving the historical observations. Experiments with datasets have shown that our proposed approach outperforms existing state-of-the-art robot mapping systems and is particularly suitable for mapping unexplored areas. In its actual implementations on aerial and ground vehicles, the proposed system achieves real-time performance with limited onboard computational resources.
items.abstract_zh: 在这封信中，我们提出一种体积建图系统，它利用并行计算有效计算占据栅格地图（OGM）和欧氏距离变换（EDT）。与用于高精度结构重建的这些建图器不同，我们的系统增量构建全局EDT，并输出高频局部距离信息，用于在线机器人运动规划。所提出系统利用来自多种类型传感器输入的大量数据构建OGM。使用GPU编程技术，系统在局部体积内并行快速计算EDT。新观测通过并行波前算法持续集成到全局EDT中，同时保留历史观测。数据集实验表明，我们提出的方法优于现有最先进的机器人建图系统，并且特别适合建图未探索区域。在飞行器和地面车辆上的实际实现中，所提出系统在有限车载计算资源下实现了实时性能。
items.comment: Published in RA-L 2022. Author-accepted manuscript. Code: https://github.com/JINXER000/GIE-mapping

items.id: cvf:CVPR2026:An Efficient Token Compression Framework for Visual Object T
items.title_en: An Efficient Token Compression Framework for Visual Object Tracking
items.title_zh: 一种用于视觉目标跟踪的高效Token压缩框架
items.abstract_en: Refining visual representations by eliminating their internal feature-level redundancy is crucial for simultaneously optimizing the performance and computational cost of models in visual tracking. To enhance their performance, many contemporary Transformer-based trackers leverage a larger number of historical template frames to capture richer spatio-temporal cues. However, this strategy leads to a massive number of input visual tokens. This creates two critical issues: it imposes a quadratic computational burden and can also degrade the tracker's overall performance. To bridge this gap, we propose a compress-then-interact tracking framework, ETCTrack, that learns to efficiently compress template tokens from historical template frames into a robust target representation, moving beyond handcrafted rules. Our method first employs the Adaptive Token Compressor to dynamically construct compact yet highly discriminative template tokens by filtering out redundant visual tokens. These refined template tokens are then processed by our Hierarchical Interaction Encoder to achieve a deep, adaptive interaction with the search features. Refined search features ensure subsequent precise target localization. Experiments on seven benchmarks demonstrate that our method outperforms current state-of-the-art trackers. ETCTrack-B224 reduces the number of template tokens by 60%, leading to a 21.4% reduction in MACs with only a 0.4% drop in accuracy. The source code are available at https://github.com/PJD-WJ/ETCTrack.
items.abstract_zh: 通过消除视觉表示内部的特征级冗余来精炼视觉表示，对于同时优化视觉跟踪模型的性能和计算成本至关重要。为提升性能，许多当代基于Transformer的跟踪器利用更多历史模板帧来捕获更丰富的时空线索。然而，这一策略会导致输入视觉Token数量巨大。这带来两个关键问题：造成二次计算负担，并且还可能降低跟踪器的整体性能。为弥补这一差距，我们提出一种先压缩后交互的跟踪框架ETCTrack，它学习将历史模板帧中的模板Token高效压缩为鲁棒的目标表示，超越手工设计的规则。我们的方法首先采用自适应Token压缩器，通过滤除冗余视觉Token来动态构建紧凑且高度判别性的模板Token。随后，这些精炼后的模板Token由我们的分层交互编码器处理，以与搜索特征实现深度、自适应的交互。精炼后的搜索特征确保后续精确的目标定位。在七个基准上的实验表明，我们的方法优于当前最先进的跟踪器。ETCTrack-B224将模板Token数量减少60%，使MACs降低21.4%，而精度仅下降0.4%。源代码见 https://github.com/PJD-WJ/ETCTrack。
items.comment: Accepted to CVPR 2026

items.title_en: Visible Light Communication using Led-Based AR Markers for Robot Localization
items.title_zh: 用于机器人定位的基于LED AR标记的可见光通信
items.abstract_en: A method of information transmission using visual markers has been widely studied. In this approach, information or identifiers (IDs) are encoded in the black-and-white pattern of each marker. By analyzing the geometric properties of the marker frame - such as its size, distortion, and coordinates - the relative position and orientation between the camera and the marker can be estimated. Furthermore, by associating the positional information of each marker with its corresponding ID, the position of the camera that takes the image picture can be calculated. In the field of mobile robotics, such markers are commonly utilized for robot localization. As mobile robots become more widely used in everyday environments, such visual markers are expected to be utilized across various contexts. In environments where robots collaborate with humans - such as in cell-based manufacturing systems in factories or in domestic settings with partner robots - it is desirable for such markers to be designed in a manner that appears natural and unobtrusive to humans. In this paper, we propose a method for implementing an ArUco marker in the form of illumination. In the proposed method, LEDs are arranged in accordance with the grid pattern of the marker, and the blinking frequency of each LED is determined based on the corresponding black or white cell. As a result, the illumination appears uniformly bright to the human eye, while the camera can capture variations in the blinking frequency. From these differences, the black-and-white pattern can be reconstructed, enabling the identification of the marker's tag information. We develop a prototype system, and conduct experiments which are conducted to evaluate its performance in terms of recognition accuracy under varying distances and viewing angles with respect to the ArUco marker.
items.abstract_zh: 使用视觉标记进行信息传输的方法已被广泛研究。在该方法中，信息或标识符（ID）被编码在每个标记的黑白图案中。通过分析标记边框的几何特性——如其尺寸、畸变和坐标——可以估计相机与标记之间的相对位置和姿态。此外，通过将每个标记的位置信息与其对应ID关联，可以计算拍摄图像的相机位置。在移动机器人领域，此类标记通常用于机器人定位。随着移动机器人在日常环境中得到更广泛使用，此类视觉标记有望在多种场景中得到应用。在机器人与人类协作的环境中——例如工厂中的单元制造系统或家庭环境中的伙伴机器人——期望此类标记被设计成对人类而言显得自然且不突兀。在本文中，我们提出一种以照明形式实现ArUco标记的方法。在所提出方法中，LED按照标记的网格图案排列，每个LED的闪烁频率根据对应的黑色或白色单元格确定。结果，照明对人眼显得均匀明亮，而相机能够捕捉闪烁频率的变化。根据这些差异，可以重建黑白图案，从而能够识别标记的标签信息。我们开发了一个原型系统，并进行了实验，以评估其在不同距离和相对于ArUco标记的观察角度下的识别准确率性能。

items.title_en: Lodos: A Lightweight Simulator Designed for Contact-Rich Interactions with Detailed Meshes
items.title_zh: Lodos：一个为与详细网格进行富接触交互而设计的轻量级仿真器
items.abstract_en: In recent years, massively parallelized rigid-body simulation has played a central role in robotics research, enabling rapid progress in areas such as reinforcement learning, stochastic optimal control, and randomized smoothing-based trajectory optimization. Particularly in contact-rich settings, the scalability of such simulations in large part depends on well-optimized representations of collision geometry, often requiring a coarse approximation of the underlying surfaces using primitives such as spheres, capsules, cylinders, and boxes. Whenever the complexity of the surfaces or the precision demands of the application render such approximations insufficient, it is instead necessary to employ mesh-mesh collisions, which impose a significant reduction in throughput. This paper proposes a simulation framework designed from scratch to address this bottleneck, with novel routines for broadphase and narrowphase collision detection as well as the subsequent contact dynamics computation. As experimentally validated, the framework matches existing well-established simulators in terms of physical faithfulness, and can achieve approximately an order of magnitude higher throughput in the detailed mesh-mesh collision setting that it specializes in. The source code is available at https://github.com/martius-lab/lodos.
items.abstract_zh: 近年来，大规模并行化刚体仿真在机器人研究中发挥了核心作用，推动了强化学习、随机最优控制和基于随机平滑的轨迹优化等领域的快速进展。特别是在富接触场景中，此类仿真的可扩展性在很大程度上取决于经过良好优化的碰撞几何表示，通常需要使用球体、胶囊体、圆柱体和长方体等基元对底层表面进行粗略近似。当表面复杂度或应用的精度要求使此类近似不足时，就需要转而采用网格-网格碰撞，而这会显著降低吞吐量。本文提出一个从零开始设计的仿真框架以解决该瓶颈，其中包含用于宽相与窄相碰撞检测以及后续接触动力学计算的新颖例程。经实验验证，该框架在物理保真度方面与现有成熟仿真器相当，并在其专门处理的详细网格-网格碰撞设置中实现约一个数量级的更高吞吐量。源代码可在 https://github.com/martius-lab/lodos 获取。

items.title_en: Moving Horizon Estimation and Constrained Model Predictive Control for Balancing a Wheel-Legged Robot Under Unknown Disturbances
items.title_zh: 未知扰动下轮腿机器人平衡的滚动时域估计与约束模型预测控制
items.abstract_en: Wheel-legged robots balance on two wheels while using articulated legs to change height, absorb impacts, and cross uneven terrain. On hardware, the balance controller must rely on noisy inertial and encoder measurements, and it must reject disturbances that are not known in advance, such as payloads and wind, without exceeding motor torque limits. This paper presents a moving horizon estimator (MHE) combined with an offset-free, constrained model predictive controller (MPC) for the sagittal balance of a 9.95 kg wheel-legged robot. The estimator uses a virtual-leg model augmented with a horizontal hip force, a body pitch torque, and a gyroscope bias. Its accelerometer model removes the predicted hip acceleration, and its process noise is increased when an impact is detected. We evaluate the approach in MuJoCo with simulated sensor noise, bias, quantization, and delay, and compare it with LQR baselines that use ground-truth state, a complementary filter, or the same MHE. In a driving, squatting, reversing, and bowing sequence, MPC with MHE reduced the RMS speed error to 0.11 m/s, compared with 0.24 m/s for LQR with ground-truth state. Under an unknown 2 kg payload and a 10 N headwind, the mean position error in wind was 6 cm, compared with 81 cm for LQR with ground-truth state. Across a 3 $\times$ 4 grid of payloads and headwinds, LQR with the same estimator fell in 3 of 12 combinations, compared with 1 of 12 for MPC. These results are limited to simulation on flat ground, and experimental validation on hardware remains future work.
items.abstract_zh: 轮腿机器人依靠两个轮子保持平衡，同时使用关节腿改变高度、吸收冲击并穿越不平地形。在硬件上，平衡控制器必须依赖带噪声的惯性测量和编码器测量，并且必须在不超过电机力矩限制的情况下抑制事先未知的扰动，例如负载和风。本文提出一种滚动时域估计器（MHE），与无偏约束模型预测控制器（MPC）相结合，用于一台9.95 kg轮腿机器人的矢状面平衡。该估计器使用一个虚拟腿模型，并加入水平髋部力、身体俯仰力矩和陀螺仪偏置。其加速度计模型去除预测的髋部加速度，并在检测到冲击时增大过程噪声。我们在MuJoCo中对该方法进行评估，模拟传感器噪声、偏置、量化和延迟，并将其与使用真值状态、互补滤波器或相同MHE的LQR基线进行比较。在驾驶、下蹲、倒车和鞠躬序列中，采用MHE的MPC将RMS速度误差降至0.11 m/s，而使用真值状态的LQR为0.24 m/s。在未知2 kg负载和10 N逆风下，风中的平均位置误差为6 cm，而使用真值状态的LQR为81 cm。在负载和逆风的3×4网格中，使用相同估计器的LQR在12种组合中有3种摔倒，而MPC在12种组合中有1种摔倒。这些结果仅限于平坦地面上的仿真，硬件实验验证仍是未来工作。

items.title_en: Payload generalization on feedforward control actions for trajectory tracking in robots with rigid and elastic joints
items.title_zh: 刚性与弹性关节机器人轨迹跟踪中前馈控制动作的负载泛化
items.abstract_en: Industries employ robots for repetitive tasks due to their high precision and performance, typically achieved through feedforward control actions based on an accurate robot description. However, an exact dynamic model can be difficult to obtain, especially for robots with elastic elements or when the payload changes. Learning-based feedforward approaches are promising for trajectory tracking under model uncertainties, but typically face generalization issues when task parameters vary. This paper proposes a novel method to generalize the feedforward control action with respect to payload parameters, independently of the underlying controller. Firstly, the minimal number of example objects needed for payload generalization is derived. Then, an algorithm is proposed to execute the same trajectory with a new payload, given only its parameters, without knowledge of the robot's dynamic model and even in the presence of elastic joints. The effectiveness of the proposed algorithm is validated in simulations and experiments on tracking tasks with different robots and controllers. Two sets of experiments are performed: on a standard Franka Emika Panda robot, and on a Franka Emika Panda robot equipped with an elastic wrist.
items.abstract_zh: 工业界使用机器人执行重复性任务，因为其具有高精度和高性能，这通常通过基于精确机器人描述的前馈控制动作来实现。然而，精确的动力学模型可能难以获得，尤其是对于具有弹性元件的机器人或负载发生变化时。基于学习的前馈方法在模型不确定性下的轨迹跟踪中具有前景，但当任务参数变化时通常面临泛化问题。本文提出一种新方法，使前馈控制动作相对于负载参数进行泛化，且不依赖于底层控制器。首先，推导负载泛化所需的最少示例物体数量。然后，提出一种算法，在仅已知新负载参数的情况下，用新负载执行相同轨迹，无需知道机器人动力学模型，甚至在有弹性关节的情况下也可行。所提算法在不同机器人和控制器的跟踪任务中通过仿真和实验验证了有效性。进行了两组实验：一组在标准Franka Emika Panda机器人上，另一组在配备弹性腕部的Franka Emika Panda机器人上。

items.title_en: Smart Visual Beacons with Asynchronous Optical Communications using Event Cameras
items.abstract_en: Event cameras are bio-inspired dynamic vision sensors that respond to changes in image intensity with a high temporal resolution, high dynamic range and low latency. These sensor characteristics are ideally suited to enable visual target tracking in concert with a broadcast visual communication channel for smart visual beacons with applications in distributed robotics. Visual beacons can be constructed by high-frequency modulation of Light Emitting Diodes (LEDs) such as vehicle headlights, Internet of Things (IoT) LEDs, smart building lights, etc., that are already present in many real-world scenarios. The high temporal resolution characteristic of the event cameras allows them to capture visual signals at far higher data rates compared to classical frame-based cameras. In this paper, we propose a novel smart visual beacon architecture with both LED modulation and event camera demodulation algorithms. We quantitatively evaluate the relationship between LED transmission rate, communication distance and the message transmission accuracy for the smart visual beacon communication system that we prototyped. The proposed method achieves up to 4 kbps in an indoor environment and lossless transmission over a distance of 100 meters, at a transmission rate of 500 bps, in full sunlight, demonstrating the potential of the technology in an outdoor environment.
items.title_zh: 使用事件相机的异步光通信智能视觉信标
items.abstract_zh: 事件相机是受生物启发的动态视觉传感器，以高时间分辨率、高动态范围和低延迟响应图像强度变化。这些传感器特性非常适合与广播视觉通信信道协同实现视觉目标跟踪，用于分布式机器人中的智能视觉信标应用。视觉信标可通过高频调制发光二极管（LED）构建，例如车辆前照灯、物联网（IoT）LED、智能建筑灯等，这些在许多现实场景中已经存在。事件相机的高时间分辨率特性使其能够以远高于经典帧相机的数据速率捕获视觉信号。在本文中，我们提出一种新颖的智能视觉信标架构，包含LED调制和事件相机解调算法。我们定量评估了所原型化的智能视觉信标通信系统中LED传输速率、通信距离与消息传输精度之间的关系。所提方法在室内环境中实现最高4 kbps，并在全日照下以500 bps的传输速率实现100米距离上的无损传输，展示了该技术在室外环境中的潜力。

items.title_en: V3DSAM: Semantic-Geometric Loop Verification and Geometry-Anchored Persistent Instance Mapping for Feed-Forward Dense SLAM
items.title_zh: V3DSAM：面向前馈稠密SLAM的语义-几何回环验证与几何锚定的持久实例建图
items.abstract_en: To address unreliable cross-view association in long-sequence feed-forward dense SLAM, this letter presents V3DSAM, an open-vocabulary semantic dense SLAM system that establishes physical correspondences at both the scene and object levels. The system combines feed-forward geometric estimates from VGGT-SLAM 2.0 with open-vocabulary semantic observations from SAM3. We introduce semantic-geometric dual-scale loop verification, which identifies false loop closures using pixel-level bidirectional reprojection and object-level 3D spatial correspondences, without accessing backbone-internal features. We further propose geometry-anchored persistent instance mapping, which defines physical instances through class-constrained 3D connectivity in an optimized global coordinate system and assigns global IDs without inter-frame identity propagation. The proposed verifier rejects all four false loop candidates in our TUM RGB-D evaluation, while long-sequence ScanNet experiments show improved instance identity consistency. Thus, V3DSAM reduces dependence on internal backbone features and temporal ID propagation for robust long-term cross-view association.
items.abstract_zh: 为解决长序列前馈稠密SLAM中不可靠的跨视角关联问题，本文提出V3DSAM，一种开放词汇语义稠密SLAM系统，在场景和对象两个层面建立物理对应关系。该系统将来自VGGT-SLAM 2.0的前馈几何估计与来自SAM3的开放词汇语义观测相结合。我们引入语义-几何双尺度回环验证，利用像素级双向重投影和对象级三维空间对应来识别错误回环闭合，而无需访问骨干网络内部特征。我们进一步提出几何锚定的持久实例建图，在优化后的全局坐标系中通过类别约束的三维连通性定义物理实例，并在不进行帧间身份传播的情况下分配全局ID。在TUM RGB-D评估中，所提出的验证器拒绝了全部四个错误回环候选，而ScanNet长序列实验显示实例身份一致性得到提升。因此，V3DSAM减少了对骨干网络内部特征和时间ID传播的依赖，以实现稳健的长期跨视角关联。

items.title_en: E-VLC: A Real-World Dataset for Event-based Visible Light Communication And Localization
items.abstract_en: Optical communication using modulated LEDs (e.g., visible light communication) is an emerging application for event cameras, thanks to their high spatio-temporal resolutions. Event cameras can be used simply to decode the LED signals and also to localize the camera relative to the LED marker positions. However, there is no public dataset to benchmark the decoding and localization in various real-world settings. We present, to the best of our knowledge, the first public dataset that consists of an event camera, a frame camera, and ground-truth poses that are precisely synchronized with hardware triggers. It provides various camera motions with various sensitivities in different scene brightness settings, both indoor and outdoor. Furthermore, we propose a novel method of localization that leverages the Contrast Maximization framework for motion estimation and compensation. The detailed analysis and experimental results demonstrate the advantages of LED-based localization with events over the conventional AR-marker--based one with frames, as well as the efficacy of the proposed method in localization. We hope that the proposed dataset serves as a future benchmark for both motion-related classical computer vision tasks and LED marker decoding tasks simultaneously, paving the way to broadening applications of event cameras on mobile devices. https://woven-visionai.github.io/evlc-dataset
items.title_zh: E-VLC：用于基于事件的可见光通信与定位的真实世界数据集
items.abstract_zh: 使用调制LED的光通信（例如可见光通信）是事件相机的一项新兴应用，这得益于其高时空分辨率。事件相机可简单地用于解码LED信号，也可用于相对于LED标记位置定位相机。然而，尚无公开数据集用于在各种真实世界设置中对解码和定位进行基准测试。据我们所知，我们提出了首个公开数据集，它由事件相机、帧相机以及与硬件触发精确同步的真值位姿组成。该数据集提供了在不同场景亮度设置（室内和室外）下具有不同灵敏度的多种相机运动。此外，我们提出一种新的定位方法，利用对比度最大化框架进行运动估计和补偿。详细分析和实验结果表明，基于事件的LED定位优于基于帧的传统AR标记定位，也证明了所提方法在定位中的有效性。我们希望所提数据集能够同时作为运动相关经典计算机视觉任务和LED标记解码任务的未来基准，为拓宽事件相机在移动设备上的应用铺平道路。https://woven-visionai.github.io/evlc-dataset

items.title_en: VisionSIM: Beyond Idealized Sensors - A Multi-Modal Simulator for Robot Perception
items.title_zh: VisionSIM：超越理想化传感器——面向机器人感知的多模态仿真器
items.abstract_en: Robotic perception increasingly relies on heterogeneous sensor suites combining cameras with emerging modalities (event, SPAD, iToF/dToF, and thermal). Yet existing simulators idealize these sensors, hiding critical modality-specific failure modes that limit real-world deployment. We present VisionSIM, a unified, physically grounded simulation platform that elevates sensor realism to a first-class concern by modeling the raw physical measurement process for diverse conventional and emerging modalities. We expose fine-grained control over physical sensor parameters, reproducing failure modes overlooked by general-purpose simulators: pileup and glare for LiDAR; phase wrapping, saturation, and motion artifacts for iToF; refractory drops for event cameras; and history-dependent emission for thermal cameras. This enables principled cross-modality comparison on identical scenes and trajectories. We release the platform and a large indoor dataset with synchronized raw measurements and rich ground-truth annotations.
items.abstract_zh: 机器人感知日益依赖异构传感器套件，将相机与新兴模态（事件、SPAD、iToF/dToF和热成像）相结合。然而，现有仿真器将这些传感器理想化，掩盖了限制现实世界部署的关键模态特定失效模式。我们提出VisionSIM，一个统一的、基于物理的仿真平台，通过对多种传统和新兴模态的原始物理测量过程建模，将传感器真实性提升为首要关注点。我们提供对物理传感器参数的细粒度控制，复现通用仿真器忽略的失效模式：LiDAR的堆积和眩光；iToF的相位卷绕、饱和与运动伪影；事件相机的不应期丢事件；以及热成像相机的历史相关发射。这使得能够在相同场景和轨迹上进行有原则的跨模态比较。我们发布该平台以及一个大型室内数据集，包含同步的原始测量和丰富的真值标注。

items.title_en: PrimeSim: A Generalist World Model Simulator from Large-Scale Cross-Embodiment Demonstrations
items.title_zh: PrimeSim：基于大规模跨具身演示的通用世界模型模拟器
items.abstract_en: A robot world model that serves as a simulator must do more than generate plausible videos: it must faithfully follow commanded actions, maintain consistency across camera views, and sustain coherent long-horizon rollouts. We present PrimeSim, an action-conditioned, multiview world model simulator that addresses these challenges through progressive midtraining and posttraining. Starting from a pretrained video generator, we midtrain on 30,110 hours of robot demonstrations spanning 22 platforms. To improve action following, we introduce a unified cross-embodiment action representation and frame-aligned dual-path conditioning to strengthen action-frame correspondence. To maintain multiview consistency, we develop view-aware interleaved attention with explicit camera identities, enabling cross-view information exchange while preserving view-specific representations. We further introduce a fast-video, slow-memory posttraining framework that transforms the bidirectional video generator into an efficient autoregressive simulator. By combining fast causal generation, self-rollout training, and hierarchical temporal memory, PrimeSim mitigates error accumulation from self-generated histories and supports coherent long-horizon simulation. PrimeSim runs at 10.1 FPS, remains stable over long-horizon rollouts on rigid and deformable manipulation tasks, and transfers to held-out platforms within 100 to 200 gradient steps where the pretrained backbone does not. Against five open-source action-conditioned world models it leads four of the five WorldSimProbe suites and posts the best overall EWMBench score, while fine-grained local calibration still trails the field; its rollouts are faithful enough to support GRPO-based policy optimization. We release the model weights, inference code, and training code.
items.abstract_zh: 作为模拟器的机器人世界模型不能仅生成看似合理的视频：它必须忠实跟随指令动作、保持跨相机视图的一致性，并维持连贯的长时程推演。我们提出PrimeSim，一种动作条件下的多视图世界模型模拟器，通过渐进式中间训练和后训练来应对这些挑战。从预训练视频生成器出发，我们在涵盖22个平台的30,110小时机器人演示上进行中间训练。为改善动作跟随，我们引入统一的跨具身动作表示和帧对齐双路径条件化，以增强动作与帧的对应关系。为保持多视图一致性，我们开发了带有显式相机身份的视图感知交错注意力，在保留视图特定表示的同时实现跨视图信息交换。我们进一步引入快视频、慢记忆的后训练框架，将双向视频生成器转变为高效的自回归模拟器。通过结合快速因果生成、自推演训练和分层时间记忆，PrimeSim缓解了来自自生成历史的误差累积，并支持连贯的长时程模拟。PrimeSim以10.1 FPS运行，在刚性和可变形操作任务的长时程推演中保持稳定，并能在100到200个梯度步内迁移到留出平台，而预训练骨干无法做到。与五个开源动作条件世界模型相比，它在五个WorldSimProbe套件中的四个上领先，并取得最佳的EWMBench总体得分，而细粒度局部校准仍落后于该领域；其推演足够忠实，可支持基于GRPO的策略优化。我们发布模型权重、推理代码和训练代码。
